description: Get full definition of one tag: display name, description, severity, category, source (system vs custom), public-report visibility, usage counts, plus `linked_rules` — the custom rules currently producing this tag (id, name, active flag). Fetch a specific rule's full config via `get_custom_rule`. Returns 404 for a retired (archived) tag this organization does not own, including every archived system tag.
name: get_tag_definition
title: Get Tag Definition
